What We Do

Installing a home or business backup generator is more than just a smart investment—it’s peace of mind that your power will stay on when you need it most. At Performance Energy, we take pride in delivering expert generator installation services backed by industry-leading equipment and a team of certified professionals. From site preparation to final testing, we handle every step with precision and attention to detail.

Our process begins with evaluating your property and power needs to help you select the right generator system. Once the plan is in place, we prepare the installation site outside your home or facility, ensuring it meets all safety and code requirements. Our team then places the generator, runs the natural gas or LP fuel lines, installs the automatic transfer switch, and completes all essential electrical connections. Every component is installed with care to ensure safe, reliable performance for years to come.

But our work doesn’t stop there. We fully test the system to make sure everything is functioning as it should, walk you through how it works, and ensure your generator is ready to respond instantly when the power goes out. With Performance Energy, you’re not just getting a generator—you’re getting a complete, worry-free installation backed by ongoing support and service.
